cvEn:
Mordehai Polzik, son of Bella and Aharon, was born on 24 Adar 5686 (10 March 1926) in Tel Aviv. When he was a year old, the family moved to Petah Tikva, where he attended the "Netzah Yisrael" elementary school and then continued his studies at the school of Kibbutz Givat HaShlosha.

From his youth he belonged to the youth movement Hashomer Hatzair, and he was a member of the "Hapoel" football team in the moshava. He was an alert, sturdy boy with broad shoulders.

In April 1942 he took part in one of the first trips of the youth movement to Masada and Ein Gedi. Beside a bonfire the young people had lit, grenades attached to the belt of the group's escort suddenly exploded from the heat of the fire. Eight people were killed and dozens wounded in the explosion. Mordehai was wounded in the abdomen and bore his injury in silence. For several days he fought for his life in the hospital, and on 25 Nisan 5702 (12 April 1942) he died. He was laid to rest in the cemetery in Petah Tikva. He left behind his parents and a sister.
